analysis.title: Director, Forward-Deployed AI Solutions
analysis.location: Philadelphia, PA (hybrid) or approved remote states
analysis.fit_rationale: Strong alignment on hands-on AI/automation building, data workflow understanding, and shipping practical solutions. Candidate has deep Python/SQL/ETL expertise, experience with LLM-based tools (RAG, agents, Copilot), and a track record of driving projects from ambiguity to adoption (e.g., capacity forecasting, ETL pipelines). Gaps: limited direct healthcare data experience, no formal leadership title, and some AI work is project-level or research rather than production enterprise deployments.
strengths: Expert-level Python, SQL, ETL, and data validation—core to the role's data logic requirements.
Proven ability to build and ship automation (capacity reports, ETL pipelines) with measurable outcomes.
Hands-on experience with LLM-based tools: RAG, agentic workflows, Copilot, and AI-assisted development.
Strong track record of solving ambiguous operational problems (capacity forecasting, performance engineering) with minimal oversight.
Experience training and enabling teams (CA APM consulting, client training) supports adoption and enablement responsibilities.
Familiarity with data governance and responsible AI considerations from regulated industries (finance, healthcare-adjacent).
gaps: No direct experience with real-world healthcare data (claims, EHR, labs) or life sciences workflows.
Leadership experience is informal (mentorship, consulting) rather than formal director-level management.
Some AI projects are personal or research-level (e.g., job-search pipeline, lakehouse project) not production enterprise deployments.
Limited experience with low-code tools and enterprise-scale productionization of AI solutions.
No explicit experience with build-vs-buy evaluation of AI platforms in a corporate setting.
tailoring_plan: 1. Highlight healthcare-adjacent data governance experience (e.g., finance/regulated industry) and emphasize transferable skills. 2. Frame AI projects (job-search pipeline, lakehouse) as evidence of practical AI integration and build-vs-buy judgment. 3. Emphasize consulting and training experience as leadership and enablement proof. 4. Address healthcare data gap by showing eagerness to learn and any relevant coursework or self-study. 5.
